t: # Short Obligatory Prayer ## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon. An Janeno Nyasacha ni ichweya mondo ang’eyi kendo apaki. Awacho sani kuom nyawona kendo kuom ekoni kuom dhier na kendo kuo mmwanduni. Onge Nyasaye machielo ngang’ mak mana in, Jakony e ndalo mag chandruok, Nyasaye manyalo duto.
